components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Used for moving to the next steps and major submit actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: bold; border: none; transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input-text { background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; color: #0f172a; font-size: 14px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input-text:focus { border-color: #2563eb; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2); background: #ffffff; }

narrative.overview: This system represents a clean, high-tech engineering aesthetic that blends computer science vibes with institutional structure. It is designed to be highly functional, structured, and formal, reflecting the engineering nature of the Big Data Club at HCMUT.
keyCharacteristics: Technocentric Accent: High-contrast blue and cyan gradients that highlight active elements and progress metrics.
Structural Integrity: Reliance on solid borders and clear segmentations rather than heavy drop shadows, especially in dark mode.
User-Centric Progress: Seamless, auto-persisted multi-step form navigation with visible stepper indicators.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Vibrant primary tech blue is reserved strictly for interactive indicators, primary call-to-actions, and active state indicators, ensuring they stand out immediately.

rules.name: The Flat Dark Rule
rules.body: Dark mode surfaces must never use drop shadows. Elevation is represented solely by border color intensity and container background light levels.

dos: Do preserve the multi-step progress when a user returns by reading from local storage.
Do use uppercase cyber badges for section tags and status updates.
donts: Don't use generic black borders or flat gray highlights. Use themed slate-300 or dark blue/cyan borders instead.
Don't use standard heavy drop shadows on dark mode cards.
